item.text: {"question_id":"5B.7","answer":"The supplied record supports limited evidence collection and a clear instance of correction, but not a demonstrated system of reliable, independently evaluated economic policymaking. BMAS commissioned studies using representative surveys, microsimulation, administrative documentation, provider surveys, and statistical analysis, and published public budget documents; however, these materials show research design or information availability, not reliable publication, completed reform, observed outcomes, or proven use in correcting policy (BATCH-0008-E024; BATCH-0008-E025; BATCH-0008-E027; BATCH-0017-E005). Independent oversight identified substantial weaknesses: Parliament and the public could not assess whether pension subsidies were appropriate, federal administration delayed projects and support-programme processing, and the Finance Ministry preserved business veto influence while proposing a parallel procedure rather than ending it (BATCH-0003-E001; BATCH-0003-E009; BATCH-0003-E015). The Council of Economic Experts further found that weak and untimely data infrastructure prevented comparable real-time evaluation during the COVID-19 and energy crises; proposed improvements were not shown as enacted in 2023 (BATCH-0009-E007). There is stronger evidence of institutional correction in the response to the Constitutional Court’s budget ruling: Scholz accepted the Court’s authority and described a supplementary-budget and compliance process, although the supplied material does not establish the eventual legislative outcome (BATCH-0016-E016). The contemporaneous reporting nevertheless characterized Scholz as un具体 and insufficiently acknowledging error, so the record supports partial correction under external legal compulsion but substantial transparency, evaluation, implementation, and learning limitations (BATCH-0024-E013). Cum-Ex evidence is excluded from the substantive 2023 economic-learning assessment because it concerns earlier Hamburg conduct, despite 2023 scrutiny (BATCH-0004-E002;
